Files (binary copies from the npm package pdfjs-dist@6.2.108; not modified):
  pdf.min.mjs          <- pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs
  pdf.worker.min.mjs   <- pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs

Safari note: this build iterates ReadableStream with `for await`, which Safari (iOS 18.x) does not support.
js/manual-text.js adds ReadableStream.prototype[Symbol.asyncIterator] before importing pdf.min.mjs, only when it is missing.
Do NOT edit the files above; update js/manual-text.js instead.
